walkthrough.short: Walk round {pairs} keeping your {hand} shoulder toward them, and keep looking at each other. No hands.
walkthrough.long: Nobody takes hands for this one. Walk forward round {pairs} with your {hand} shoulder toward them, turning your body as you go so the two of you are looking at each other the whole way round — that is what makes it a shoulder round rather than a do-si-do. {amount}, and you finish where that leaves you.

walkthrough.short: Half a shoulder round with {pairs}, {hand} shoulders, eyes on each other: you end on their place.
